scope: one checkpointed 1e-7 pass from pristine C, not a learning-rate sweep
optimizer: Adam, bias correction, same upstream defaults
gradient_checkpoint: same upstream first-layer wrapper, once before baseline validation
teacher_cache: existing work/refinement-v1-targets, all 40 hashes checked, no regeneration
selection: step zero eligible; select lowest mean among candidates whose max repeated loss < baseline min and mean gain exceeds max(baseline range, candidate range)
stop: if no selected/reloaded trained checkpoint passes loss gate, no generation or M4; stop learning-rate tweaks on this tiny corpus
conditional_screen: only after loss gate and saved-parameter integrity: existing 24-task development screen, fresh C and pinned MXFP4 controls, judge solves/truncations/length together; no automatic Mac test
opened_12_task_set: regression evidence only; not untouched selection data
